FAQs

Are utilities included in the rent, and if so, which ones?
In most rental properties, utilities are included in the rent and cover heat and hot water, with renters responsible for the electric and gas costs. However, some buildings may have unique policies, where water may be included in a flat fee or handled differently. Let your client know that you can reach out to the landlord or property manager on their behalf to answer any specific questions about utility costs.
